title: juniperus oxycedrus var. parvifolia
intro: Juniperus oxycedrus var. parvifolia, commonly known as Prickly Juniper, is a small to medium-sized evergreen tree or shrub native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Prickly Juniper include its ability to act as a diuretic, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, making it useful in treating urinary tract issues and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Prickly Juniper include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
